title: MERFISHEYES store conventions
description: The names and spellings particular producers use (SpatialData-DB, spatialdata-io, 10x, the MERFISHEYES writers), read by the viewer (lib/spatialdata/conventions.ts) and by scripts/validate_store.py, so the two cannot drift. Rules of the format itself stay in code and in the profiles of docs/specs/. See docs/specs/conventions.md.

curatedDefaultTable.description: Where a store names its default table: root attribute `attribute`, key `key` (SpatialData-DB: metadata_general["Default Table"]).

fallbackTableName.description: The table read when none is named; else the first by name.

featureIndexColumns.description: var columns tried for the feature names after the one the var frame declares as its index.

defaultColumnPriority.description: obs columns chosen first as the default colouring, in order.

notDefaultColumns.description: Positional or bookkeeping obs columns: offered in the picker, never the default colouring.

positionColumns.description: obs columns that hold a cell's position (its x, y or z under the names producers use): never offered as a colour, since the position is what is drawn. The browser preview and the SpatialData viewer both leave them out.

cellOutlineElements.description: Shapes element names the Shapes layer draws as cell outlines, best first.

pointSiblingSuffix.description: Suffix of the Point element beside a region that holds each cell's centre and radius (SpatialData-DB writes `<region>_for_vitessce`).

squareBinPattern.description: A polygon region whose name contains this (case-insensitive) is a grid of square bins (Visium HD).

bucketRegions.description: Region of each public bucket a catalog names by s3:// URL.

species.description: A catalog's organism (lower case) → the spelling Explore filters on.

platforms.description: A catalog's technology → the spelling Explore filters on.
